digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter value maps and boundary enforcement
propositions: The ticket-type map _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE exists in two separate dict literals under adapters/, creating risk of silent divergence between Cloud and DataCenter create paths
No guard test exists to prevent a third copy of the ticket-type map from being introduced, unlike the existing guards for status and priority maps
The two existing ticket-type map copies are content-identical in values but differ in key order, so unification is behavior-preserving on both deployments
External consumer test outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py reads _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute, requiring it to remain resolvable after relocation via an aliased import
The ticket-type map must be relocated to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py alongside existing maps and imported under the historical private alias to maintain the J2 precedent pattern
The boundary guard must be extended to enforce exactly one ticket-type map literal across the adapters/ hierarchy, with mutation testing to verify it catches reintroduction of duplicates
